notes: This contract records the portable C++ TCK check for the official IEEE 1516.1 standard order and transportation lookup services. The source uses only the standard C++ RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs plus the standard library; the adapter supplies the provider package, FOM, endpoint, and callback configuration. It verifies lifecycle admission, mandatory Receive and TimeStamp orders, mandatory reliable and best-effort transportation types, cross-federate handle stability, round trips, invalid-name and invalid-handle errors, and standard cleanup without asserting provider-specific behavior.

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador order and transportation type lookup, name round-trip, lifecycle admission, invalid-input, federation membership, and cleanup services
